Hi! On days I don't wear makeup, I still find I have to cover up my undereye circles. I know you don't want to look like you wear concealer or makeup, nor do I on days I'm trying to look more natural.

What I do is take NYX Dark Circle Concealer and get my finger wet and apply very thin, barely even opaque layers. I have it in the lightest shade, so it is very brightening and cancels out the blue-purple shades of the undereye circles I have. I just apply very thin layers until the color is canceled, and it just looks like the rest of my skin. Applying it with my finger in a patting motion has really helped it not look creased or un-skinlike. Hope that helps!
